notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the ordinary time-management lifecycle. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador, FederateAmbassador, logical-time, and standard-library APIs; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies time-role enablement, logical-time and lookahead queries, deferred lookahead changes, ordinary and alternate advance boundaries, grant delivery, asynchronous-delivery controls, and standard pre-connect, pre-join, duplicate-role, in-progress, backward-time, and duplicate-disable failures without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador time-role, time-advance, logical-time query, and asynchronous-delivery services with FederateAmbassador time callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador time-management declarations and FederateAmbassador time callbacks
